guide.cosmiccore.page.1:
§5§lCosmic Core§r
§8A reactor builder's guide§r

The core generator focuses starlight into a singularity and turns it into RF.

The rule: more power means more risk.
guide.cosmiccore.page.2:
§5§lBuilding§r

1. Place the controller.
2. Choose a size: 5x5x5, 7x7x7 or 9x9x9. This choice is final!
3. Turn on the §dPreview§r in the GUI: ghost blocks show what goes where, red = wrong block.
guide.cosmiccore.page.3:
§5§lBlocks§r
§lCasing:§r floor, ceiling
§lRune Frame:§r corners
§lFocus Glass:§r ceiling ring
§lShield Emitter:§r below the core
§lCrystal:§r above the core
§lCore:§r center

The inside must be empty. The preview shows everything.
guide.cosmiccore.page.4:
§5§lPorts§r

Ports can replace any casing block.

§lEnergy Port:§r pushes RF into cables.

§lItem Port:§r accepts fuel from hoppers or pipes.
guide.cosmiccore.page.5:
§5§lOperation§r

Right-click the controller to open the GUI.

§6Fuel:§r Star Dust, ender pearl, nether star ...

§3Stabilizer:§r obsidian, netherite scrap ...
guide.cosmiccore.page.6:
§5§lResonance§r

After ignition the output builds up from 20 % to 100 % over about 30 seconds.

Sneak + right-click the controller to see the first build error in chat.
guide.cosmiccore.page.7:
§5§lPower level§r

Each level adds:
§b+ output§r (a lot)
§6+ fuel use§r
§c+ instability§r

Levels 1 to 10.

Bigger reactors give more per level and are more stable.
guide.cosmiccore.page.8:
§5§lInstability§r

Fuel heats the core. From 20 % the field holds it there, using stabilizers - the higher the level, the more.
§e70 %§r: core turns red
§685 %§r: alarm
§4100 %§r: 10 s countdown - below 95 % saved, else §lcollapse§r!
guide.cosmiccore.page.9:
§5§lThe cosmos§r

Clear sky above the ceiling: §b+25 %§r output, with a Star Funnel §b+50 %§r.

At night +25 %, at full moon up to +50 %.

The End: always +40 %, but less stable.
guide.cosmiccore.page.10:
§5§lTips§r

- Test on level 1 first.
- Never run out of stabilizers.
- On alarm, lower the level or press Stop.
- In creative, §dBuild§r places the structure instantly.

§8Good luck, starsmith.§r
guide.cosmiccore.page.11:
§5§lStar Funnel§r

Place it right on the center of the ceiling.

With a clear sky it draws cosmic energy from space and §bdoubles§r the sky bonus.
guide.cosmiccore.page.12:
§5§lAsteroids§r

At night asteroids drift across the sky - small, medium or large.

Large ones give 1M RF, small ones 50,000 RF.
guide.cosmiccore.page.13:
§5§lCosmic Energy Laser§r

Build §d4 lasers§r on the ceiling: one north, east, south and west of the center.

They become orbiting energy particles that shoot asteroids and collect their energy.
message.cosmiccore.not_running: Ignite the generator first - level and overdrive can only be changed while running
gui.cosmiccore.overdrive.warning_up: Per level: RF generation x2, instability x3! One Overdrive Particle from your inventory is consumed and NOT returned when deactivated or when the reactor is dismantled.
gui.cosmiccore.overdrive.warning_down: The level is deactivated. The Overdrive Particle is lost.
message.cosmiccore.overdrive.missing: You need an Overdrive Particle in your inventory
tooltip.cosmiccore.overdrive.effect: Install in a formed reactor: RF x2, instability x3
guide.cosmiccore.page.14:
§5§lOverdrive§r

Install Overdrive Particles in the controller: §bRF x2§r but §cinstability x3§r per level.

5x5x5: 1, 7x7x7: 2, 9x9x9: 3 levels.
Only on a formed reactor. If it breaks, overdrive is lost.
console.cosmiccore.title: COSMIC CORE
guide.cosmiccore.page.15:
§6§lUltimate Core§r

11x11x11, levels 1-12, the strongest output and the most stable.

§bVacuum energy:§r with a clear sky it generates power even without fuel.

Its first ignition shakes the sky of the whole world.
tooltip.cosmiccore.stability_module: Each module -12 % instability, field holds lower (max 4)
guide.cosmiccore.stabilizer_note: From 20 % the field holds instability and uses stabilizers for it.
guide.cosmiccore.modules:
§5§lModules§r

§6Efficiency Module:§r -15 % fuel use each.

§3Stability Module:§r -12 % instability each, the field holds 3 % lower.

Up to 4 per slot in the controller.
guide.cosmiccore.loot:
§5§lAsteroid Loot§r

The laser pulls asteroids down to the top of the star funnel, where they burst. Their fragments spiral down into the funnel: star dust, ores, diamonds - large ones even neutron star fragments and rarely quasar essence.

The loot goes into the controller loot slots and can be piped out of the item port.
jei.cosmiccore.info.controller: Heart of the core generator. When placing it you pick the size (5x5x5 to 11x11x11) and optionally star funnel and lasers. Right-click opens the controls; in creative "Build" places the structure automatically. Everything else is in the Cosmic Handbook.
jei.cosmiccore.info.core: The singularity at the center of the structure. Grows with the power level and collapses at 100 % instability.
jei.cosmiccore.info.funnel: Optional above the structure: catches cosmic energy from the sky and focuses it into the core (sky bonus).
jei.cosmiccore.info.laser: Four lasers around the star funnel form a tractor beam that pulls asteroids down at night. They burst at the top of the funnel and their loot goes into the controller.
jei.cosmiccore.info.efficiency_module: Inserted in the controller: -15 % fuel use per module (max 4).
jei.cosmiccore.info.stability_module: Inserted in the controller: -12 % instability per module, the field holds 3 % lower (max 4).
jei.cosmiccore.info.overdrive_particle: Consumed for each overdrive stage: double power, triple instability.
jei.cosmiccore.info.energy_port: Outputs the generated energy (RF/FE) to adjacent cables.
jei.cosmiccore.info.item_port: Accepts fuel, stabilizers and modules via pipes and outputs asteroid loot.
